page.notes: The woodcut ornament below the closing words is not transcribed as text. The first line of the page ("constaret") starts mid-sentence and is a fragment carried over from the previous page. The line "Erant ea millia septemdecim cum du-" is followed by "ducentis" on the next line; the printed reading there is partly unclear ("ducentis.:" with a stray mark), so the hyphenation is marked as read. The running head and the "THEO." catchword are read from a low-contrast scan and should be checked.
